setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step phrase on steps 1-4 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a MIDI device on OUT 1, in C major at 90 BPM with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). A pattern has four step pages of 16 steps; here only page 1 has trigs and the Pattern editor has not been opened. Each channel plays a range of steps (start step to end step), which you will set at the end to hear one page at a time.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Pattern (5,8) to open Pattern Trig and tap steps 17-20, 33-36 and 49-52 (grid rows 5-7, columns 1-4) so each step page holds four steps. All twelve steps light.
steps.title: Add trigs on pages 2 to 4

steps.caption: Press Pattern (5,8) again to open Pattern Note. Hold K1 and tap (1,7), the root, C: degree 0 for step 1. The cell lights.
steps.title: Hold K1 and set the first note

steps.caption: Keep K1 held and tap (2,6), (3,5) and (4,4): degrees 1, 2 and 3, which are D, E and F. All four notes are lit.
steps.title: Set the other three notes

steps.caption: Press the first page button (9,8): the four notes are lit on page 1.
steps.title: Check page 1

steps.caption: Press the page buttons (10,8), (11,8) and (12,8) in turn. Each page shows the same four notes lit. Holding K1 while you entered them copied each note to all four pages.
steps.title: Check pages 2 to 4

steps.caption: Press Pattern (5,8) again to open Pattern Velocity. Hold K1 and tap (1,2), (2,2), (3,2) and (4,2): the second level, velocity 117, on steps 1-4. Press the first page button (9,8): the four cells are lit on page 1.
steps.title: Copy the dynamics to every page

steps.caption: Press the page buttons (10,8), (11,8) and (12,8) in turn: the same four cells are lit on every page.
steps.title: Check velocity pages 2 to 4

steps.caption: Press Channel (3,8). Hold step 1 and tap step 4 to set the channel range to steps 1-4. Press Play at (1,8), then Stop: C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65), each at velocity 117.
steps.title: Hear page 1

steps.caption: Hold step 17 and tap step 20 to move the range to steps 17-20. Play, then Stop. Then hold step 33 and tap step 36, play and stop again. Both pages play the same four notes at velocity 117.
steps.title: Hear pages 2 and 3

steps.caption: Hold step 49 and tap step 52. Play, then Stop: page 4 plays C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocity 117 too, so every page matches.
steps.title: Hear page 4

title: Copy notes and dynamics across the four step pages
